commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Rename chatbot to Johnny and add greeting/farewell message
commitResults.messageBody:
Rename Duke class to Johnny and update all references in README files.
  Add startup banner, greeting, and farewell output on exit.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add echo loop and exit on 'bye' command
commitResults.messageBody:
Read user input in a loop, echo each command back, and exit
  gracefully when the user types 'bye'.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add task list storage and retrieval
commitResults.messageBody:
Store user input in a fixed-size array and display all stored
  items with numbered indices when the user types 'list'.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add mark task as done functionality
commitResults.messageBody:
Add 'mark <number>' command to mark tasks as completed.
  Display done status as [X]/[ ] in the task list with a
  'Here are the tasks in your list:' header.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add unmark command to reverse task done status
commitResults.messageBody:
Add 'unmark <number>' command that sets a task back to not done
  and displays confirmation with the [ ] status indicator.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Extract Task class into separate file
commitResults.messageBody:
Move task description and done status into a Task class with
  markAsDone(), markAsNotDone(), and toString() methods.
  Replace parallel String[] and boolean[] arrays with a Task[] array.

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: Add present-changes-visually skill for Claude Code
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a project-specific Claude Code skill that generates GitHub-style
  split-view HTML diffs of repository changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add test-ui skill and UI test plan
commitResults.messageBody:
Create a Claude Code skill that runs scripted UI tests against the
  CLI app and verifies output. Add 4 initial test cases covering
  greet/exit, add/list, mark, and unmark. Update AGENTS.md to require
  test plan updates and test runs after every code change.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add todo, deadline, and event task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Support 'todo', 'deadline /by', and 'event /from /to' commands.
  Display task type prefix [T]/[D]/[E] in list and mark/unmark output.
  Dates/times are stored as plain strings for now.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Use inheritance for Todo, Deadline, and Event task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract Todo, Deadline, and Event as subclasses of Task.
  Each overrides toString() to add its type prefix and fields.
  Store all tasks polymorphically in a Task[] array.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add error handling with custom JohnnyException
commitResults.messageBody:
Handle empty todo descriptions and unrecognized commands by
  throwing JohnnyException with user-friendly error messages.
  Unrecognized input now shows an error instead of being added as a task.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add delete command and switch to ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace fixed-size Task[] array with ArrayList<Task> for dynamic sizing.
  Add 'delete <number>' command that removes a task and reports
  the updated task count.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Use Command enum and switch statement for input handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace chained if/else-if with a Command enum and switch statement.
  Split user input into command word and arguments, convert to enum
  via valueOf(), and dispatch with switch for cleaner control flow.

commitResults.messageTitle: nit: Add import statements
feat: Save tasks to disk automatically on every change
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Storage class that writes the task list to ./data/johnny.txt in a
  pipe-delimited format whenever a task is added, deleted, marked, or
  unmarked. Each task subclass provides a toFileString() method for
  serialization. The data directory is created automatically if it does
  not exist.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Load saved tasks from disk on startup
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Storage.load() that reads ./data/johnny.txt and reconstructs the
  task list from the pipe-delimited format. Each line is parsed back into
  its original Task subtype (Todo, Deadline, Event) with the correct
  done/not-done status. If the file does not exist, the app starts with
  an empty list. A warning is shown if loading fails due to an I/O error.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add input validation and error handling for all commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Validate mark/unmark/delete arguments for missing, non-numeric, and
  out-of-range task numbers. Validate deadline and event commands for
  missing delimiters (/by, /from, /to), empty descriptions, and empty
  date/time fields. Handle EOF on stdin gracefully. In Storage, skip
  corrupted or empty lines when loading and use try-with-resources to
  prevent file handle leaks on write errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: merge: Integrate branch-Level-7 (file persistence and input validation)
feat: Parse dates as LocalDate and display in MMM dd yyyy format
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and Event now store dates as java.time.LocalDate instead of raw
  strings. Dates must be in yyyy-MM-dd format; invalid formats are rejected
  with a clear error message. Dates are displayed as MMM dd yyyy (e.g.,
  Oct 15 2019) and saved in ISO format for correct round-trip loading.

commitResults.messageTitle: merge: Integrate branch-Level-8 (date parsing with LocalDate)
refactor: Extract Ui class from Johnny
commitResults.messageBody:
Move all user-facing output methods (greeting, farewell, error display,
task status messages, list display) and input reading (Scanner) into a
dedicated Ui class. Johnny.main now delegates all I/O through a Ui
instance instead of using static print helpers.

This is the first step in decomposing the monolithic Johnny class into
single-responsibility classes (Ui, TaskList, Parser, Johnny).

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Extract TaskList class to wrap ArrayList<Task>
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a TaskList class that encapsulates the raw ArrayList<Task>
with domain-specific operations (add, delete, get, size, getAll).
Johnny, Storage, and Ui now operate on TaskList instead of
ArrayList<Task>, improving abstraction and aligning with the Single
Responsibility Principle.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Extract Parser class for command parsing and input validation
commitResults.messageBody:
Move all input parsing logic out of Johnny.main() into a stateless
Parser utility class. Parser provides parseCommand(), parseArguments(),
parseTaskIndex(), parseTodo(), parseDeadline(), and parseEvent() — each
returning the parsed result or throwing JohnnyException on invalid input.
Johnny.main() is now a thin orchestrator that delegates parsing to Parser
and actions to TaskList/Storage/Ui.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Convert Johnny from static main to instance-based design
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the static main() monolith with a constructor that initialises
Ui, Storage, and TaskList, and a run() method that drives the command
loop. main() is now a one-liner: new Johnny(filePath).run(). This
makes Johnny instantiable and testable, and removes the need to pass
ui/storage/tasks as parameters to saveTasks().

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Organize classes into johnny.* package hierarchy
commitResults.messageBody:
Move all classes from the default package into a structured package
  layout: johnny (root), johnny.command, johnny.storage, johnny.task,
  and johnny.ui. Each package groups classes by responsibility. Add
  package declarations and cross-package imports to all files. Update
  the test plan compile command accordingly.

commitResults.messageTitle: merge: Integrate Gradle build support
build: Update Gradle mainClass to johnny.Johnny
commitResults.messageBody:
Point the application plugin's mainClass at the new package path
  after the package reorganization.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: Add JUnit tests for Parser class
commitResults.messageBody:
Add ParserTest with 24 test cases covering all six public methods:
  parseCommand, parseArguments, parseTaskIndex, parseTodo, parseDeadline,
  and parseEvent. Tests verify both happy paths and error cases including
  invalid input, missing delimiters, and malformed dates.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: Add comprehensive JUnit tests for Parser class
commitResults.messageBody:
Add ParserTest with 43 test cases covering all six public methods.
  Tests verify return values, toFileString() round-trips, boundary
  indices, error messages, and every validation branch including empty
  inputs, invalid dates, missing delimiters, and out-of-range indices.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: Add JUnit tests for Task, TaskList, and Storage classes
commitResults.messageBody:
Add TaskTest (15 tests) covering toString/toFileString for all three
  task types with done/undone state transitions. Add TaskListTest (10
  tests) covering add, delete, get, and constructor operations. Add
  StorageTest (15 tests) covering load parsing for each task type,
  corrupted/empty/invalid line handling, save format, directory creation,
  and a full save-load round-trip verifying data integrity.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: Add JUnit test coverage target to post-code-update workflow
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a step requiring JUnit tests to be updated after each code change
  to maintain a 50% coverage target, focusing on high-value methods
  (complex logic, core business rules, critical data paths). Include
  ./gradlew test as the verification command.

commitResults.messageTitle: build: Rename shadow JAR output from duke.jar to johnny.jar
commitResults.messageBody:
Update the shadowJar archiveFileName to match the project name.
  The fat JAR is created with ./gradlew shadowJar and output to
  build/libs/johnny.jar.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: Add Javadoc comments to non-private classes and methods
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Javadoc to 20 previously undocumented constructors and methods
  across Johnny, Task, Deadline, Event, TaskList, Storage, and Ui.
  Coverage increases from 37% to 75% of non-private members.

commitResults.messageTitle: style: Add SE-EDU Java coding standard skill and fix field visibility
commitResults.messageBody:
Create a project-specific Claude skill that encodes the SE-EDU
  intermediate Java coding standard (45 rules covering naming, layout,
  statements, and Javadoc). Reference it from AGENTS.md so all future
  code changes follow the standard automatically.

  Fix the only violations found in the current codebase: Deadline.by,
  Event.from, and Event.to were declared protected but are only accessed
  within their own class. Changed to private final, matching the
  standard's guidance to minimize field visibility.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a find command that searches task descriptions for a given
  keyword (case-insensitive). Matching tasks are displayed in a
  numbered list. An error is shown if no keyword is provided.

  The search delegates to a new TaskList.find() method, keeping the
  command logic in Johnny.java thin. The FIND enum value is resolved
  automatically by the existing Parser.parseCommand() via valueOf(),
  so no parser changes were needed.

commitResults.messageTitle: merge: Integrate Javadoc comments for non-private classes and methods
merge: Integrate SE-EDU Java coding standard skill and field visibility fixes
merge: Integrate Level-9 find command
style: Fix Checkstyle violations in switch indentation, Javadoc, and line wrapping
commitResults.messageBody:
The SE-EDU Checkstyle configuration (caseIndent=4) requires case labels indented 4 spaces from the switch keyword. Fixed in Johnny.java and Storage.java.

Also replaced case UNKNOWN with default to satisfy MissingSwitchDefault, added missing Javadoc to four Ui methods, and moved lambda ( to the end of the preceding line in ParserTest.java to satisfy SeparatorWrap.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add JavaFX GUI with shared command processing
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a JavaFX window with a scrollable monospace conversation area,
  command input, and Send button. Support submitting commands using
  either Enter or the button, while retaining the bye command.

  Reuse Johnny's parser, storage, and task logic across the CLI and GUI
  by extracting single-command processing and routing Ui output through
  a Consumer. Add automated tests and a manual GUI test case.

commitResults.messageTitle: merge: Integrate Checkstyle fixes
merge: Integrate Level-10 JavaFX GUI
refactor: Use varargs for multi-line UI output
commitResults.messageBody:
Change Ui.printIndented() to accept a variable number of messages,
  reducing repeated calls when displaying multi-line responses.

  Strengthen JohnnyTest to verify the complete task-added response and
  confirm that the displayed output remains unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: merge: Integrate A-Varargs UI refactoring
